needs_human.note: Switching a member target away and back in one page visit reuses the earlier evaluation without re-evaluating (R7-1).; A Smart Collection named twice in `in:` (for example `in:"Weekly" in:weekly`) is evaluated twice in resolveInNames, because classifyNames does not deduplicate smart folders. This is harmless to the result but breaks the one-evaluation-per-name bound in SPEC-CORE-116 §10.
